name: bubblebarrel
_comment_dependencies: react/react-dom pinned here (matching apps/staff, the Next.js app) so the workspace root — where `next` itself hoists to, since only apps/staff depends on it — resolves the SAME React apps/staff's code uses. Without this, npm hoists `next` to root but leaves root's implicit react resolution ambiguous vs. apps/marketing's react@18, causing next build to bundle two react-dom copies across one render tree (Minified React error #31 on the built-in /404 /_error page). apps/marketing keeps its own nested react@18 copy since its version differs from this pin. Known npm-workspaces issue: https://github.com/vercel/turborepo/issues/9335

scripts.test: npm run test:marketing && npm run test:staff
